findings.claim: MMD training runs cannot create a run manifest because _manifest constructs create_run_manifest(...) but never returns it; the inherited CORAL run path then passes None into update_run_manifest, which calls manifest.update(...) and will fail before training starts.
proof_refs: git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/mmd.py showed MMDExperimentRunner._manifest ends after a bare create_run_manifest(...) call with no return statement.

git diff --cached -- src/pada3dacb/experiments/coral.py showed CORALExperimentRunner.run_fold assigns manifest = self._manifest(...) and then calls update_run_manifest(manifest_path, manifest, "PENDING"). MMDExperimentRunner inherits that run_fold.
git diff --cached -- src/pada3dacb/experiments/run_manifest.py showed update_run_manifest(path, manifest, status, ...) immediately calls manifest.update(updates), requiring a dict.

findings.claim: CDAN discriminator input dimension is derived from aggregator.embedding_dim or a top-level token_dim, but model construction derives the actual embedding/token dimension from model.tokenizer.token_dim. A valid nested tokenizer.token_dim configuration can therefore build a discriminator with the wrong input_dim and fail when conditional_outer_product outputs z_dim * 3 features.
proof_refs: git show :src/pada3dacb/experiments/cdan.py showed _build_adaptation_method computes dim = int(self.config.model.get("aggregator", {}).get("embedding_dim", self.config.model.get("token_dim", 128))) * 3.
git diff --cached -- src/pada3dacb/models/pada3dacb.py showed build_pada3dacb sets token_dim=int(tokenizer.get("token_dim", 128)) and PADA3DACBOutput.z is produced by AttentionAggregator(token_dim).

git diff --cached -- src/pada3dacb/adaptation/cdan.py and src/pada3dacb/adaptation/domain_discriminator.py showed conditional_outer_product flattens z with 3 class probabilities, while DomainDiscriminator.forward rejects tensors whose second dimension differs from config.input_dim.
